'''Rodolfo (Rudy) Fernández Farrés''' (born [[April 4]], [[1985]] in [[Palma de Mallorca]], [[Balearic Islands]]) is a [[Spain|Spanish]] professional [[basketball]] player.  He is a 6'6" [[shooting guard]].

Fernandez has been participating in international basketball competitions since he was sixteen years old.  He played at the European Junior Championships and the [[2004 Summer Olympics]].  Most recently, he represented Spain at the [[2006 FIBA World Championship]], where he contributed 9.1 points per game and won a gold medal.  He is currently affiliated with the professional club [[Joventut Badalona]], although he is widely considered an eventual [[NBA Draft]] pick <ref>[http://probasketball.about.com/od/nbadraft/a/top1002007.htm http://probasketball.about.com/od/nbadraft/a/top1002007.htm]. Retrieved 3 September 2006.</ref>.
